summary.en: Israeli drones struck a Syrian operative planning attacks for Iran near the Lebanon border, while a separate strike wounded six people in Lebanon. Houthi forces carried out a deadly attack on Riyadh's King Khalid Airport, prompting condemnation from Damascus and a phone call between Syrian and Saudi foreign ministers to discuss regional security. Syrian security forces intensified anti-ISIS operations and pursued former regime loyalists, while private security firms clashed with a new Syrian security mogul and Syrian forces foiled drug smuggling on the Iraq and Jordan borders. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels droner slo til en syrisk operativ som planla angrep for Iran nær Libanon-grensen, mens et separat angrep såret seks personer i Libanon. Houthiene gjennomførte et dødelig angrep på Riyadhs King Khalid-flyplass, noe som førte til fordømmelse fra Damaskus og en telefon mellom syriske og saudiske utenriksministre for å diskutere regional sikkerhet. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker intensiverte anti-IS-operasjoner og forfulgte tidligere regimelojalister, mens private sikkerhetsfirmaer kolliderte med en ny syrisk sikkerhetsmogul og syriske styrker avverget narkotikasmugling på Irak‑ og Jordan-grensen. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
